Start automatic setup
Stop

First, manually enable Mika accessibility. Mika will try to enable Developer options, USB and wireless debugging, and pair this phone. If the system limits automatic actions, Mika will ask you to complete the affected steps manually. Enter any screen lock password and confirm system prompts yourself.
Manually enable the Mika accessibility service in Settings. Setup will continue automatically once it is connected.
Opening Developer options…
Enabling USB debugging…
Opening wireless debugging…
Opening the pairing window. Mika will read the code and pair automatically.
Complete the confirmation or identity check on the system screen. Setup will then continue automatically.
Automatic setup has paused. Return to Mika to finish the steps manually, or try again.

The system prevents Mika from reading this settings page, so automatic setup has paused. Return to Mika, complete the current step below manually, then tap “Start automatic setup”. Completed steps will be skipped.
Automatic setup stopped. You can continue manually or start again.
Phone setup is complete.
Model assistance for unfamiliar menus
When a setting is not recognized, use the current on-device main model to interpret menu titles. Processing stays on this phone.
When a setting is not recognized, send selected settings-menu titles to your configured online main model. Screenshots, device details and pairing codes are not sent.
Configure and select a main model in Settings → Models to enable assistance. Automatic rules and manual setup remain available.
The current model is identifying the next setup step…
The model could not identify a suitable next step. Return to Mika to continue manually, or try again.
